name: Zahir Hossain Baidya

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Fakir Chand College’s 2022–23 magazine includes Zahir Hossain Baidya’s poem “The Lone-Wolf” and identifies him at that time as an English Honours student.

His Kabita Live poem “Sinister Sense” contrasts a reported proposal about stray dogs with the threat of violence against women. Its disturbing questions lead to an appeal for protection; this is the poem’s rhetoric, not a biographical account of the writer.
